card.text: Explore Hekate in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Hekate is a main-belt asteroid. Explore its calibrated convex reconstruction from DAMIT, version 2019-06-24. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. The source admits an alternative pole solution; this view uses model 3088.

shape.title: DAMIT model 3088
shape.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
